lines.zh: 锁子甲磨得沙沙响，一步不乱。
lines.en: The chainmail whispers with every measured step.

lines.zh: 二十步一停，这是军团的老规矩。
lines.en: Twenty paces, then halt — the legion's old rule.

lines.zh: 盾牌压住左肩，行军才稳。
lines.en: Shield braced on my left shoulder keeps the march steady.

lines.zh: 短剑挂在右腰，走路也不碰响。
lines.en: My gladius hangs quiet at my right hip.

lines.zh: 我踩着前一个人的脚印走。
lines.en: I step in the footprints of the man ahead.

lines.zh: 铁靴踏地，像鼓点一样齐。
lines.en: Iron boots strike the ground like a drumbeat.

lines.zh: 锁子甲里全是汗，但我不能停。
lines.en: Sweat fills my mail, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 队伍拉成长线，我走在中间。
lines.en: The column stretches out; I hold the middle.

lines.zh: 这双鞋走过高卢的泥地。
lines.en: These boots have crossed the mud of Gaul.

lines.zh: 盾沿擦着路边的草，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My shield rim hisses through the roadside grass.

lines.zh: 走慢些，后面的弟兄跟不上。
lines.en: Slow down — the brothers behind are falling back.

lines.zh: 我抬脚很轻，怕踩坏农人的田。
lines.en: I keep my steps light, sparing the farmer's field.

lines.zh: 行军时我不说话，只数呼吸。
lines.en: On the march I say nothing, only count breaths.

lines.zh: 铁片相撞的声音，我听了一辈子。
lines.en: The clatter of iron plates has filled my whole life.

lines.zh: 前面的旗子一偏，我就跟着转。
lines.en: When the standard leans, I turn with it.
One more stretch and we make camp.
I stand at rest, yet never let the shield go.

lines.zh: 锁子甲有点重，我换了换脚。
lines.en: The mail grows heavy; I shift my feet.
Wind from the north smells of rain.

lines.zh: 我数着盾上的刮痕打发时间。
lines.en: I count the scratches on my shield to pass the time.

lines.zh: 锻打这身甲用了整整三天。
lines.en: Three whole days at the forge made this armor.
Without an order, I do not move.
I blow the dust from my scabbard.

lines.zh: 营火的味道让我想起家乡。
lines.en: The smell of campfire takes me home.

lines.zh: 我在心里默念队列口令。
lines.en: I recite the formation commands in my head.

lines.zh: 盾牌底沿垫在土里，省点力气。
lines.en: I rest the shield's lower rim in the dirt to save strength.
My crest sits crooked; I cannot be bothered.
Standing this long, my knees stiffen.

lines.zh: 远处有鸦叫，我抬了一下眉。
lines.en: A crow calls far off; I raise an eyebrow.
I must keep my eyes on the standard.

lines.zh: 铁环在衣下轻轻互相磨。
lines.en: The iron rings grind softly beneath the cloth.
No one comes today — good time to polish my mail.
Halt. State your name.

lines.zh: 你不是军团的人，我看得出。
lines.en: You are no legionary; I can tell.
My shield edges forward a little.
You carry the smell of a forge.

lines.zh: 这身锁子甲，你打不出来吧？
lines.en: Could you forge mail like this? I doubt it.
Those boots will not last a long march.

lines.zh: 我把短剑往里收了半寸。
lines.en: I slide my gladius a half-inch back.

lines.zh: 咱们之间保持十步，如何？
lines.en: Ten paces between us — agreed?
I do not care for the look in your eye.

lines.zh: 罗马不认得你，我认得你的武器。
lines.en: Rome does not know you; I know your weapon.
Stand back — my shield knows no friends.

lines.zh: 甲片凹了一块，我还站着。
lines.en: A ring is dented; I am still standing.
It hurts, but the line must hold.
I grit my teeth and swallow the blood.
The medic would not bother with this.
I plant my feet and keep the shield level.
The iron took half the blow for me.
I catch my breath and grip the hilt.

lines.zh: 疼得眼睛发黑，还能看路。
lines.en: My sight darkens, but I can still see the road.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，随即补回原位。
lines.en: I fall back a step and take my place again.
Do not celebrate; I have not fallen.

lines.zh: 那是面包吗？给我掰一块。
lines.en: Is that bread? Break me a piece.

lines.zh: 军粮只剩硬饼了，你救了我。
lines.en: Rations are down to hard biscuit — you saved me.
I smell olives.
Stop waving it; I only want to look.
One bite of salted fish is worth ten miles.
I set my shield half down.

lines.zh: 这味道像我母亲的灶台。
lines.en: That smell is my mother's hearth.

lines.zh: 我咽了下口水，队列差点乱了。
lines.en: I swallow hard and nearly break formation.
Half a loaf, and I take your watch.

lines.zh: 别拿它逗我，军团人不喜欢玩笑。
lines.en: Do not tease me with it; legionaries dislike jests.
I pull off one gauntlet.
Wine? Only a small mouthful.

lines.zh: 我肚子叫得比军鼓还响。
lines.en: My stomach growls louder than the war drum.
Keep it — I only wanted the smell.
This scent makes me forget my stance.
One step closer and I will take it.
You hit my shield; that is on you.
Steady! The shield wall must not break.

lines.zh: 我肩头一顶，把你推回去。
lines.en: I brace my shoulder and shove you back.

lines.zh: 锁子甲硬，撞上来很疼吧。
lines.en: Mail is hard — that must have hurt.
Do not shove; the line will break.
I put you behind my shield.
You struck iron, not me.
The rings leave my ribs numb.
Next time go around, not into the rim.
Not in camp, not this.

lines.zh: 我的婚约留在罗马城里。
lines.en: My betrothal stayed in Rome.

lines.zh: 别用这种眼神看我，我在站岗。
lines.en: Do not look at me like that; I am on duty.
After this war, perhaps.
I take off my helm, then put it back.
The armor is cold; the heart is not.
A wife waits for my pay.
Such words belong by the campfire.
I turn away and look to the standard.
In the legion we speak only of sword and shield.
This iron nail will serve me.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起，甲片哗啦一响。
lines.en: I bend to pick it up; the mail clatters.
What lies on the ground is unowned.
I tuck the coin into my belt.
Whose arrow is this? Mine now.

lines.zh: 我捡得很慢，怕弯腰时被偷袭。
lines.en: I pick it up slowly, wary of a blade while bent.

lines.zh: 这块布正好补我的内衬。
lines.en: This cloth will patch my underlayer.
I hang it on my shield's rim.

lines.zh: 军团人不留东西在地上。
lines.en: A legionary leaves nothing lying about.

lines.zh: 捡完了，我拍掉手上的土。
lines.en: Done — I brush the dirt from my hands.
Target fixed. Draw blade.
I see you. Do not move.

lines.zh: 盾举起来，这是开战的意思。
lines.en: Shield up — that means we begin.
You have entered my ten paces.

lines.zh: 我的脚跟已经扎进土里。
lines.en: My heels are planted.
The gladius leaves its sheath almost silently.
This time I do not mean to retreat.
The standard is behind me; I will not yield.
You chose the wrong opponent.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过去，盾不晃。
lines.en: I close in step by step, shield steady.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的肩膀，手会先动。
lines.en: I watch your shoulder — hands move first.
Breathe slow. Wait for the gap.
My point stays trained on you.

lines.zh: 你在找我的破绽，我也在找你的。
lines.en: You hunt my gap; I hunt yours.
The eyes behind my shield do not blink.
Do not circle; I know this ground.
One inch closer is all I need.
The gladius stabs — once is enough.
Shield rim first, blade after.

lines.zh: 我压着你的武器往下砍。
lines.en: I press your weapon down and cut.
This stroke comes from legion drill.
I stab at your waist, where there is no plate.
Iron strikes iron, throwing sparks.

lines.zh: 你别急着倒下，我还有半招。
lines.en: Do not fall yet; I have half a stroke left.

lines.zh: 我把全身的重量压进剑里。
lines.en: I drive my whole weight through the blade.
The point comes out from behind my shield.
One blow, then back behind the shield.
The legion has come. Open ranks.

lines.zh: 我从雾里走出来，甲片还在响。
lines.en: I step out of the mist, mail still ringing.
Who is here? Declare yourself.

lines.zh: 我踩着泥水进场，盾先落地。
lines.en: I enter through the mud, shield down first.

lines.zh: 锻了三天的甲，就为站在这儿。
lines.en: Three days of forging, to stand here.

lines.zh: 军旗插下，这一片归罗马。
lines.en: The standard is planted; this ground is Rome's.

lines.zh: 我摘下头盔，让你看清我的脸。
lines.en: I lift my helm so you see my face.

lines.zh: 队列整齐，一步不多一步不少。
lines.en: The ranks are even, not a step off.

lines.zh: 冷风灌进锁子甲，真够受的。
lines.en: Cold wind pours through my mail — miserable.

lines.zh: 火烤着锁子甲，烫得像烙铁。
lines.en: Fire heats my mail like a branding iron.

lines.zh: 落地那下，铁环全硌进肉里。
lines.en: On landing, every ring bites into flesh.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲里，我沉得比石头快。
lines.en: Water fills my mail; I sink faster than stone.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，甲片乱响。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, armor clattering.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡在锁子甲缝里。
lines.en: An arrow wedges between my mail rings.

lines.zh: 那咒语透过铁甲钻进骨头。
lines.en: That spell seeps through iron into my bones.

lines.zh: 空肚子行军，眼前全是旗子。
lines.en: Marching empty, I see standards everywhere.

lines.zh: 雷劈在铁甲上，我整个人发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my armor and numbs me whole.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我的盾抓不住。
lines.en: The ground is gone; my shield grabs nothing.
